name: Embedding soundness unknown
problem: A system builds on a library's solutions with its own stores and prompts, but cannot see which library solution each of its parts serves, whether its parts meet the library's own cases, or how far its pinned version lags.
who_has_it: Developers of any system built on a library that uses this structure.
why_it_matters: The embedding is where users meet the library, so an unsound integration undoes the library's quality.
why_hard: Two repositories, one public and one private, change at different rates under different rules.
existing_attempts: Version pins, changelogs, contract tests, integration test suites.
